bio.summary: Segal is a retired ultrasonographer running for Boulder council. She advocates municipal ownership of utilities and seeks to reduce the university’s influence on development.
bio.note: Source availability is narrower than for questionnaire respondents; silence is not a policy position.

statements.text: Lynn Segal is running for Boulder City Council on a platform of reducing CU’s impact on city development and bringing utilities under municipal ownership.
statements.speaker: Boulder Reporting Lab reporter

statements.text: Lynn Segal, a longtime resident and activist, advocated for municipalization and mitigating CU’s impact on overall development.
statements.speaker: Peter Constas (reporting the candidate)

statements.text: The answer corresponds to the last question's answer.
